Bhavna Chandra joined NexaCorp’s SaaS division as a Staff Mobile Developer, bringing a unique blend of technical precision and collaborative mindset. Her work has consistently elevated the quality and scalability of our mobile platforms.  

Bhavna’s technical toolkit is deeply rooted in practical problem-solving. She spearheaded a Kotlin-based architecture overhaul for a flagship app, reducing crash rates by 40% and improving maintainability. Her React Native implementations balance performance with rapid iteration, supporting cross-platform consistency. Swift remains central to her identity—she designed a modular framework adopted across three teams, simplifying onboarding for new developers. She also owns our Mobile CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated testing covers 95% of critical workflows, with deployment times cut by 30% since 2023.  

Beyond code, Bhavna excels in fostering collaboration. She mentors junior developers, often pairing them with complex legacy systems to build confidence. Her ability to distill technical challenges into clear, actionable steps has streamlined sprint planning. She thrives in ambiguity, balancing tight deadlines with high-quality outcomes.  

Bhavna’s impact extends beyond her role. She initiated a knowledge-sharing series that reduced redundant troubleshooting by 25%, and her advocacy for cross-team alignment helped resolve a critical integration bottleneck. Her reliability and curiosity make her a trusted anchor in any team.  

I wholeheartedly recommend Bhavna. Her technical depth, collaborative spirit, and dedication to excellence position her as a rare asset in any high-tech environment.
